title: Poland Study Visa Pakistan — Requirements, Fees, IELTS & FAQ | SK Immigration
description: Poland study visa from Pakistan (Schengen / EU): requirements, documents, fees, IELTS, low marks, timeline and FAQ. SK Immigration Services, Rawalpindi.

faqs.question: What are Poland study visa requirements from Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Admission from a recognized Polish university; Proof of funds / tuition payment evidence as required; Passport, forms, photos; Academic documents with translations when asked. SK Immigration builds a full checklist for your case.

faqs.question: How much does it cost to study in Poland from Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Budget tuition + living + visa/insurance. Poland is generally more affordable than UK/Canada for many programmes. SK packages from PKR 50,000 cover preparation only — not tuition.

faqs.question: Do I need IELTS for Poland study visa?
faqs.answer: Many English programmes accept IELTS or alternatives (MOI / university test). Always confirm the school’s current list.

faqs.question: Can I study in Poland with low marks?
faqs.answer: Poland is often considered for flexible admissions; universities still set their own cut-offs.

faqs.question: How long does Poland student visa take from Pakistan?
What documents are needed for Poland student visa?
faqs.answer: Passport pack; Acceptance letter; Transcripts and certificates; Bank / sponsor proof; SOP and CV; Insurance.

faqs.question: Can I work while studying in Poland?
faqs.answer: Student work rights exist with limits — do not treat them as your only funding plan.

faqs.question: How to apply for Poland study visa from Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Secure admission, prepare funds/insurance/docs, then file the correct national/student visa. SK Immigration sequences the file; authorities decide.

faqs.question: What is SK Immigration’s fee for Poland study?
faqs.answer: Student packages from PKR 50,000 for preparation. Embassy and university fees are separate. No visa guarantees.

faqs.question: Do you guarantee Poland student visa approval?
faqs.answer: No. Embassies and immigration authorities decide. We prepare complete, honest files.

Poland study visa from Pakistan — purpose, funds, recognition

Poland attracts Pakistani students with English-taught programmes and mid-range living costs compared with UK/Canada. Visas still fail when the university is weak, the study purpose is unclear, or funds look borrowed for one month.

Eligibility reality check

  • Admission / acceptance from a recognized Polish institution
  • Proof of funds and tuition plan matching mission guidance
  • Health insurance and accommodation evidence when requested
  • Language evidence matching the programme (IELTS, MOI, or university test — only if accepted in writing)

How files usually move

  1. Honest shortlist (field + city + fee reality)
  2. University applications and fee letters
  3. Attestation / translations as required
  4. National student visa / residence documentation package
  5. Appointment and decision — authorities decide

Work while studying

Student work rights exist under Polish rules but change and are not a substitute for proof of funds. Plan finances as if work income is zero until you verify current limits on official pages.

Common refusal risks

  • Unrecognized or unclear colleges
  • SOP that could be written for any country
  • Unexplained sponsor money
  • Assuming “Europe no IELTS” without a written language clause
